functions.name: nov_prim_list2_l1
functions.params: int32_t n, uint32_t xyz, uint32_t rgba, uint32_t st, uint32_t st2, uint32_t clip
functions.doc: Two prim lists of n vertices on VU1 program 7 (the shadow program; 0x1fde98's twin, Veldin has no copy): the 5-quadword template 0x1c44a0 (n in its tag), the GIF state 0x160ec0 / 0x160ee0 / 0x160f00 (n << 16), st (8 bytes a vertex), rgba (4), xyz (12), MSCAL 0xc + 2 clip; then the template again with its GIF tags' CTXT bit set (+4 / +0x18 | 0x1000000: the GS's second context), the second st list st2 and a REF of the first list's rgba / xyz

functions.name: nov_strip_verts_l1
functions.doc: A strip's vertices into the scratchpad (VU0 macro; sin / cos by the VU0 micro programs 0x192 / 0x190): rec +0 the points (16 bytes: x, y, two heights), +4 the uvs (8 bytes), +0xc the count, +0x10 z the uv wobble, +0x30 the colour, +0x40 the two uv scrolls, +0x50 the phase, +0x5c the height mix; xyz (z the two heights mixed by +0x5c) to 0x70000000, the uvs + scroll 1 + the wobble to 0x70001000, + scroll 2 - the wobble to 0x70002000, the colour to 0x70003000; the wobble's angle from the point's x / y bits and the phase

functions.name: nov_strips_draw_l1
functions.doc: n scrolling strips (records of 0x60): their uv scrolls (+0x40 / +0x44 by +0x20 / +0x24 x +0x10, +0x48 / +0x4c by +0x28 / +0x2c x +0x14, wrapped to -1..1), their phase (+0x50 += +0x1c, 24 bits), the screen test (0x2221f0) of their sphere *(+8) with radius 400; seen: a REF of the GS state 0x1cac80 (TEST / CLAMP / TEX1 of both contexts), TEX0_1 / TEX0_2 of the effect textures +0x34 / +0x38 (0x21ae98), ALPHA_1 / ALPHA_2 with FIX +0x3c / +0x3d, the vertices (L1:0x262618) and the two prim lists (L1:0x21fa98; clipped unless the sphere is wholly in view)

functions.name: nov_water_grid_in_l1
functions.doc: A water tile's heights into the scratchpad grid (rows of 0x60 bytes from grid + 0x70): the frame's 16 x 16 heights (tile +0x50 + frame x 0x5c0: 0x400 bytes), then the neighbours' rows (+0x400 / +0x480 / +0x500), columns (+0x440 / +0x4c0 / +0x540) and corners (+0x580) around them

functions.name: nov_water_grid_light_l1
functions.doc: The water grid's colours and uvs (VU0 macro / MMI): per vertex its normal from the four neighbours' heights (two cross products, normalized by RSQRT), a colour from it and the vector at 0x167100 (rgba to 0x70001088, 4 bytes a vertex) and its uvs (to 0x70000780, 8 bytes); constants 0x1cad00..
functions.entry_host: if (nov_water_grid_light_fast(tile)) return;  // (the host form, novalis_water_fast.cpp: the same routine)

functions.name: nov_water_grid_xyz_l1
functions.doc: The water grid's 17 x 17 positions to 0x70002000 (12 bytes each): x / y from the tile's corner (+0 / +4) with the steps 0x1cad08 / 0x1cad0c, z the tile's height +8 plus the grid's (0x70000010..)

functions.name: nov_water_uv_scroll_l1
functions.doc: The water's uv scroll (+0x20 / +0x24 by +0x28 / +0x2c, wrapped to 0..1) and its swell (+0x30 / +0x34 by +0x38 / +0x3c through 0x221ff8, their sin / cos x +0x40): the uv table 0x1cafe0 moved by them into 0x1cae60 (the two scrolls chosen by the flags 0x1cb1b0)

functions.name: nov_water_cell_packet_l1
functions.doc: One cell (a 4 x 4 block of the 17 x 17 grid) on VU1 program 7: the template 0x1cb160, the GIF state 0x161240 / 0x161260 / 0x161280, 46 colours and 23 x 2 positions by the index tables 0x1cad40 / 0x1cae00, MSCAL mscal; then the template again (CTXT set), the uvs (indices 0x1cada0) and a REF of the first part

functions.name: nov_water_cell_l1
functions.params: uint32_t tile, int32_t cell, int32_t clip
functions.doc: A cell of a water tile: with `clip` 1 or 2, its four corners' clip codes (0x2210c0 after the two view matrices); all outside one plane: not drawn; else L1:0x262388 with MSCAL 0xe (clipped: clip 1 and a corner outside) or 0xc

functions.name: nov_water_draw_l1
functions.doc: n water tiles (records of 0x1190): VU1 program 7 set up (L1:0x2b8f98), then per tile with cells (+0x1e) and its box in view (the corners' clip codes): the grid (L1:0x261c10 with the frame 0x161220, 0x261df8, 0x2b8c08), the uv scroll (L1:0x2b80d0), its flat edges (+0x44 bits: that edge's positions' z set to the tile's +8), the GS state when its textures (+0x14 / +0x18) or alphas (+0x1c / +0x1d) differ from the last (0x161228..), and its 16 cells (L1:0x2b8cb0)
